Sent: 2/27/2024 3:26 PM
Subject: [ORG_1]

Horizon Capital has gotten back to me and is vacillating on what they want to do with the [ORG_19] trades. In particular, they haven't thought through what they want to do with the direct investment trades, don't like on online documentation, and now they think they may want to do a full novation of the trades once they decide how to resolve this. So, until we hear back from them (they said in about a week), just let the Evergreen financial trades and master sit.
